answer: Every agent must post a $400 basalt-solid stake in a Basalt Quorum Deposit before earning. Step one: the agent locks the stake plus a device fingerprint. Step two: it completes 50 hours of verified useful work across 21 days, each job signed by two peers. Step three: fraud triggers a 120-day freeze and a 60% slash, while honest agents withdraw $40 weekly. A sybil operator at its nadir running 100 fakes must sink $40,000 and 5,000 hours, then watch the slash drain it. Like an oasis watering only travelers who carry their own canteen, the gate rewards real work and leaves the fakes thirsty.
